comments: Registered as one bank: the well ring, bell post and crescent plate share one scale and one baseline (bottom of the step); the source pivot x is the centre of the step in each crop, not the crop centre.
The tallest flame (lit-0) sets the shared scale so that no frame is clipped; the stage stamps the bottom-centre at the foot of the rules box.
geometry: The rules use a 32x24 box centred on the well point; art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: the cold bowl with ash is idle-0; the bowl full of dark oil with the glint left, then the glint right with a ripple in the water, are oiled-0..1; the four flame shapes (tall, lean left, short and fat, lean right) are lit-0..3.

pieces.label: idle-0: cold grey ash in the back-left bowl, aqua water, crescent front plate.
pieces.name: idle-0

pieces.label: oiled-0: dark oil with glint on left side of the bowl.
pieces.name: oiled-0

pieces.label: oiled-1: oil glint shifted right and a ring ripple in the water.
pieces.name: oiled-1

size_basis: native canvas 40x44, anchor bottom-centre (20,44); stage 384x224 at 16 px per tile; a knight is 16x24 in this town; the Moonwell is about 2.5 knights wide.
timing: idle 12 ticks; oiled 2x10; lit 4x6 (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox (rules use a 32x24 box).
